episode.title: This GIANT ANGLERFISH Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a minimal studio water set, a colossal anglerfish takes a performer into its toothy maw, then the crew force its practical jaws open and he steps out unharmed.

shots.prompt:
ONE CONTINUOUS UNBROKEN TAKE. The camera is low and close, so the giant creature fills the whole frame from the very first second, its head and jaws reaching past the edges of the picture. One dark production element stays at the bottom edge of the frame, an out-of-focus crew head or the corner of a camera rig or a flight case, and the blue screen wall with its pale blue cross tracking markers sits far behind the creature and reads out of focus, so the shot still reads as a film set. A shallow depth of field keeps the creature's head sharp while everything behind it falls away. A hard directional lamp rakes the creature from one side and lays real shadows, while the space behind the creature stays darker than the creature itself. One giant creature faces exactly one man. The creature's jaws open wide and close over him until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth. Crew members rush in, put their hands on the creature and push its jaws open, and in the final seconds the same one man climbs out onto the set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal. The camera stays close and handheld throughout, drifting with the action, with natural motion blur.

The giant anglerfish with dark murky brown slimy skin, black glassy eyes, translucent needle-like sharp teeth, glowing esca lure, nine metres tall looms over Ihsan (ihsan_field) on the ocean_tank_set floor. The cavernous mouth closes over Ihsan until he is fully inside. Stage technicians move in, taking hold of the practical jaw mechanism and pulling the mouth open wide. Ihsan steps out unharmed onto the studio floor. Ambient sound only: water splashing, studio air handling and crew movement.
shots.violation_observation: The giant anglerfish's mouth closes over the man until his whole body is hidden inside it, then crew members put their hands on the giant anglerfish and force its mouth open, and the same man climbs out onto the set floor.
